//Enhanced Version
Killing an <link Elite or higher-ranked Combatant [#CombatantClassifications] /> spawns a seeking insectoid robot that chases enemies within 25 meters. The insectoid deals weapon-element matching damage (varying by archetype) in a 5 meter radius.

0.5 second cooldown between insectoid spawns. Insectoid kills count as weapon kills and can trigger perks, but cannot spawn more insectoids. 

#e Insectoid robot damage is increased by ?%
